question.text: A PPM stipulates 18% per annum default interest on unpaid drawdowns. Mr. Nair defaulted INR 5 crore drawdown for 60 days. Default interest (simple, ignoring compounding; 365-day basis) is approx:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Default interest = 5 crore x 18% x (60/365) = 5,00,00,000 x 0.18 x 0.1644 = INR 14.79 lakh, approximately INR 15 lakh. **The Trap:** INR 12 lakh uses 15% or 50 days. INR 18 lakh uses 73 days. INR 30 lakh uses 120 days. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C tests default-interest math. XIX-D extends to forfeiture combined. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Always cite a 365-day (actual) basis in the PPM and tie interest to the SBI MCLR + margin rather than a fixed number - fixed 18% becomes stale when rates fall.
